title: Problem with pasting notes from ChatGPT to my notes app on my iPhone
body: I’ve been using this app for almost a year now a few days ago I started seeing some problems that I’ve never seen previously when using this app I usually copy Notes from ChatGPT to my Notes app for for my private notes .A few days ago I tried to copy something from ChatGPT to the Notes app and something weird happened. The notes were pasted in a bad format and some of the notes I could not see as they were misaligned out of the screen. So please do something about this app please.
author: angelnirvana
